messages:
Maria Chen: quick sync — we need a final decision on how BYOK HSM fallback should work for customer-managed keys. auditors want clear custody boundaries and exhaustive audit logs. :eyes:
Kevin Patel: do we plan to import CMKs into our HSM or just store wrapped keys and call customer KMS for unwrap?
Maria Chen: prefer wrapped keys (envelope encryption) + our operational key in HSM. less custodian risk. still need to confirm rollback/rotate flow.
Ashok Rao: +1 for envelope. high-level: customer KMS -> wrap data key -> we unwrap using HSM only if customer grants access via asym unwrap. otherwise we proxy decrypt via keyless flow. important: never allow raw key export.
Julia Park: auditors (SOC2 + FedRAMP interest) will ask for separation of duties and proof of non-export. we'll need KMS integration logs + HSM attestation.
Kevin Patel: what about RBAC? SREs need to trigger emergency unwrap during incidents but we can't give them export perms. propose new role 'kms-emergency-unwrapper' that can call /unwrap but requires multi-approver workflow.
Maria Chen: agree. propose policy: 2-person approval via Vault/OKTA for role elevation and every unwrap request logged to long-term audit store (immutable).
Ashok Rao: sample RBAC snippet (pseudo):
```yaml
roles:
  kms-unwrapper:
    actions: [unwrap:create_request]
    requires: [approval:2]
    no_export: true
    audit_level: high
```
Julia Park: we also need to capture KMS request IDs, HSM attestation nonce, and operator identity in the audit event. retention >= 7 years for some customers.
Kevin Patel: ops burden: if we force 2 approvals for every emergency unwrap we'll explode toil at 3am. suggest automatic 2-hr grace with 2-approval required to persist results to long-term store, and short-lived ephemeral unwrapping for mitigation only.
Maria Chen: could implement ephemeral unwrap token TTL=30m + require post-incident review and retroactive approval to keep decrypted data for >30m. if not approved, auto-rekey victim artifacts.
Ashok Rao: vulnerability triage note: if a key compromise suspected, we must revoke HSM operational key, rotate envelope keys, and notify customers per SLA. playbook should include whether we can rewrap at scale.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-3245: "BYOK HSM fallback playbook + RBAC". Assignee: Ashok Rao. Due: 2026-04-02.
Julia Park: audit logging engineering questions: do we stream HSM logs to customer-managed log targets? some customers will insist on that for compliance.
Maria Chen: yes — optional feature: forward subset of telemetry (non-sensitive) to customer SIEM over syslog/TLS. must strip any secret material and include only metadata + attestation.
Kevin Patel: KMS integration note: support multiple KMS vendors (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and BYO-HSMs. need canonical mapping for key metadata and a translation layer.
Ashok Rao: automation idea: on onboarding, capture customer key policy (json), required approvals, and allowed unwrap endpoints. validate with schema.
Maria Chen: next steps: Ashok to draft playbook + RBAC roles, Kevin to prototype unwrap flow (ephemeral token + approval), Julia to list auditor requirements for logs/retention. we'll review Wed sync.
Julia Park: ack. I'll add compliance checklist items to SEC-3245.
ops-oncall: FYI — add a step to incident runbook: "if customer-managed key unwrap required, page oncall and escalate per emergency unwrap policy".
Maria Chen: thanks. tagging for visibility: @Kevin Patel @Ashok Rao @Julia Park. :lock:
